Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Halcyon onboarding info + PO reference?

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to move forward with the pilot and I wanted to confirm the steps we need so Redwood can issue a procurement reference code / PO. A few specific questions:

- I attached the vendor onboarding form (halcyon_onboarding_form.pdf). Please confirm if anything else is required (W-9, bank details, compliance attestations).
- How does Redwood handle provisional reference codes vs final PO numbers? We expect to ship in phases and may need multiple line items under a single PO.
- Can you confirm default spend cap for new accounts? We may request a temporary bump for the first month.

Also, can you confirm format for line-item descriptions? Our ops team wants to avoid mismatched SKUs when the PO is generated.

Appreciate a short checklist so we can return the paperwork today.

Best,
Samir

procure@halcyoncloud.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon onboarding info + PO reference?

Hi Samir — thanks for sending this over and welcome. Putting Connor (vendor enablement) and Priyom (procurement ops) on the thread so we can get you a definitive checklist and a temporary reference code. Short answers below then next steps:

- Required docs: completed onboarding form (received), signed W-9 (we need this), and vendor bank details for ACH. If you're a non-US entity we need equivalent tax docs — let us know.
- Reference codes: Procurement will issue a provisional reference code (P-YYYYMM-####) that you can use for initial invoicing and test receipts. We convert it to a formal PO number once billing is approved and the spend cap is set.
- Spend caps: new vendors default to $100,000 annual envelope for pilots. Temporary increases are possible with approval (send a short justification).
- Line items: include SKU + concise description (e.g., GPU-RES-16 — Reserved GPU 16GB — hours). Avoid free-text product names; our ledger maps SKUs to cost buckets.

Next steps for Halcyon to complete today:
1) Return signed W-9 and bank form to procure@redwood.com.
2) Confirm desired pilot spend cap (if requesting higher, include a brief justification & expected first-month burn).
3) Confirm whether you want separate line items per feature or aggregated (we can advise based on billing needs).

Connor/Priyom — can you create a provisional reference and advise whether we can approve a $150k temporary cap for the first 30 days if Samir sends justification?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com

Attachments: (none)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Halcyon onboarding: reference code issuance and line-item clarifications

Evelyn / Connor — quick status update and actions taken on procurement side: 

1) Provisional reference created: P-202606-8642 (assigned to Halcyon Cloud). This is usable immediately for initial invoices and test receipts.
2) Formal PO: PO-8642-202606 issued as the final PO once W-9 and bank details are validated in AP. I attached the issued PO stub (PO-8642-Redwood-issued.pdf) for your records.
3) Spend cap: temporary increase approved to $150,000 (effective 2026-06-02 through 2026-07-02) for the pilot. We will re-evaluate on 2026-07-01 with consumption numbers.
4) Line-item normalization: combined compute-related descriptors into a single canonical SKU to avoid duplication on ingestion. Mapping done as follows (internal):
   - Source items: "Reserved GPU time (N. Virginia)" + "GPU reserved (16GB)"
   - Canonical SKU: GPU-RES-16
   - Billing presentation: PO will show two line items: GPU-RES-16 (compute) and PRO-SVC-01 (professional services). If Halcyon needs finer granularity we can split on subsequent POs, but for the pilot this reduces reconciliation friction.

Next steps (who/when):
- Evelyn: confirm the external communication to Samir with PO attached (today).
- Connor: validate vendor banking details once received and flag any mismatch to AP (by 2026-06-04).
- Samir: send final bank details if not already submitted.

I'll place a ticket in PROC backlog for the July spend review (PROC-4121).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
